sn12.50:1.2: na bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa evaṃ hoti:
sn12.50:1.3: “kinnu kho kismiṃ sati kiṃ hoti, kissuppādā kiṃ uppajjati,
sn12.50:1.4: kismiṃ sati saṅkhārā honti, kismiṃ sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati phasso hoti, kismiṃ sati vedanā hoti, kismiṃ sati taṇhā hoti, kismiṃ sati upādānaṃ hoti, kismiṃ sati bhavo hoti, kismiṃ sati jāti hoti, kismiṃ sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hotī”ti?
sn12.50:2.1: atha kho bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa aparappaccayā ñāṇamevettha hoti:
sn12.50:2.2: “imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti. imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati.
sn12.50:3.1: na bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa evaṃ hoti:
sn12.50:3.2: “kinnu kho kismiṃ asati kiṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā kiṃ nirujjhati,
sn12.50:3.3: kismiṃ asati saṃkhārā na honti, kismiṃ asati viññāṇaṃ na honti …pe…
sn12.50:4.1: atha kho bhikkhave, sutavato ariyasāvakassa aparappaccayā ñāṇamevettha hoti:
sn12.50:4.2: “imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti. imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati.
sn12.50:5.1: yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ lokassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno itipi, dassanasampanno itipi, āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, passati imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, sekhena ñāṇena samannāgato itipi, sekhāya vijjāya samannāgato itipi, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno itipi, ariyo nibbedhikapañño itipi, amatadvāraṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati itipīti.
